mounts vehicles and harnesses.description: A sleek, high-speed motorcycle popular among street runners and gang scouts in Shinjuku.

mounts vehicles and harnesses.name: High-Speed Hover-Bike
mounts vehicles and harnesses.description: An advanced repulsor bike capable of skimming over flooded streets and concrete barriers.

mounts vehicles and harnesses.name: Aegis Assault Bike
mounts vehicles and harnesses.description: Heavy armored military motorcycle fitted with twin smart-gun mounts and siren arrays.

mounts vehicles and harnesses.name: Cyber-Enhanced Guard Hound
mounts vehicles and harnesses.description: A genetically modified Doberman equipped with cybernetic optics and sub-dermal armor.

mounts vehicles and harnesses.name: Drone Control Interface
mounts vehicles and harnesses.description: A neural headset and harness used to transmit direct steering commands to mounts and drones.

mounts vehicles and harnesses.name: Custom Mounting Rig
mounts vehicles and harnesses.description: A reinforced saddle fitted with magnetic locks, stirrups, and power coupling ports.

mounts vehicles and harnesses.name: Hard-Shell Storage Pods
mounts vehicles and harnesses.description: Weather-sealed hard cases that clamp onto vehicle frames or pack-drones to carry gear.

mounts vehicles and harnesses.name: Automated Cyber-Cab
mounts vehicles and harnesses.description: A self-driving corporate taxi used for discreet transit across the Neon Layer.

mounts vehicles and harnesses.name: Cargo Trailer
mounts vehicles and harnesses.description: A heavy two-wheeled tow trailer used by street vendors and smugglers to move bulk goods.

mounts vehicles and harnesses.name: Transport Van
mounts vehicles and harnesses.description: An armored panel van favored by runner teams for mobile operations and field deployments.

mounts vehicles and harnesses.name: Tactical Buggy
mounts vehicles and harnesses.description: An open-topped high-speed off-road vehicle equipped with roll cages and reinforced suspension.

mounts vehicles and harnesses.name: Snow-Track Rover
mounts vehicles and harnesses.description: A heavy tracked vehicle designed for navigating icy conditions and contaminated quarantine zones.

mounts vehicles and harnesses.name: Mizu Sub-Deck Galley
mounts vehicles and harnesses.description: A large, multi-oared river barge used for housing and heavy transport in flooded Mizu Ward.

mounts vehicles and harnesses.name: Pontoon Skiff
mounts vehicles and harnesses.description: A flat-bottomed motorboat built from salvaged pontoons, ideal for navigating shallow flooded streets.

mounts vehicles and harnesses.name: Stealth Pontoon Cruiser
mounts vehicles and harnesses.description: A long, muffled motorboat equipped with radar-dampening paint for smuggling operations.

mounts vehicles and harnesses.name: Motorized Dinghy
mounts vehicles and harnesses.description: A small inflatable rubber boat powered by a quiet electric outboard motor.

mounts vehicles and harnesses.name: Cargo Barge
mounts vehicles and harnesses.description: A massive flat-deck vessel used for transporting shipping containers along Chrome Harbor.

mounts vehicles and harnesses.name: Aegis Naval Strike Craft
mounts vehicles and harnesses.description: A fast, armored patrol boat equipped with heavy gun turrets and depth-sonar arrays.

mounts vehicles and harnesses.name: Recharge & Parking Dock
mounts vehicles and harnesses.description: A secure station where vehicles, mechs, and bio-drones can be parked, washed, and recharged.

foci and instruments.name: Shinto Spirit-Charm
foci and instruments.description: A traditional wooden or paper talisman bound with fiber-optic wire, used as a holy focus.

foci and instruments.name: Corporate ID Badge
foci and instruments.description: A high-clearance smartcard displaying corporate seals, used by corporate mages to focus spells.

foci and instruments.name: Encrypted Relic Chip
foci and instruments.description: A data storage chip containing sacred digital scriptures and spirit-binding formulas.

foci and instruments.name: Prismatic Optic Focus
foci and instruments.description: A polished glass prism mounted in chrome, used to channel light and illusion spells.

foci and instruments.name: Quantum Mana-Globe
foci and instruments.description: A floating glass orb containing glowing plasma that reacts dynamically to spellcasting.

foci and instruments.name: Laser Firing Rod
foci and instruments.description: A slender metal rod tipped with a focusing lens that shoots focused energy when casting spells.

foci and instruments.name: Biometric Conduit Wand
foci and instruments.description: A polished metal wand that connects directly into a spellcaster's neural port.

foci and instruments.name: Awakened Wood Focus
foci and instruments.description: A wand crafted from spirit-infused wood harvested from sacred shrines in Kitsune-cho.

foci and instruments.name: Spirit-Attuned Botanical Reagent
foci and instruments.description: A fresh sprig of awakened flora used by street shamans to channel natural energy.

foci and instruments.name: Cyber-Totem Icon
foci and instruments.description: A small metallic or carved icon representing a street runner's personal spirit animal or totem.

foci and instruments.name: Synth-Pipes
foci and instruments.description: An electronic wind instrument that synthesizes bagpipe tones into high-energy synthwave audio.

foci and instruments.name: Digital Beat-Pad
foci and instruments.description: A handheld electronic drum machine used by street influencers to drop combat beats.

foci and instruments.name: Laser-Harp
foci and instruments.description: A frame that projects laser beams which emit musical notes when broken by fingertips.

foci and instruments.name: Electronic Synth-Flute
foci and instruments.description: A sleek metal flute equipped with digital pitch-shifters and audio effects.

foci and instruments.name: Cyber-Lute
foci and instruments.description: An electric stringed instrument featuring a built-in amplifier and holographic display.

foci and instruments.name: Holographic Lyre
foci and instruments.description: A handheld frame that projects glowing energy strings that chime when touched.

foci and instruments.name: Sonic Pan-Flute
foci and instruments.description: A compact electronic pipe array that emits multi-frequency acoustic waves.

foci and instruments.name: Synthesizer Horn
foci and instruments.description: A brass-plated electronic horn capable of broadcasting deafening fanfares across crowds.

foci and instruments.name: Electric Viol
foci and instruments.description: A sleek carbon-fiber violin fitted with neural jacks for direct audio streaming to HUDs.

spells.name: Corrosive Flechette Pulse
components: (a drop of industrial solvent or a Sector 17 bio-reagent ampoule)
spells.description: You load a compressed burst of industrial chemical solvent or toxic Sector 17 bio-reagent into your wrist-launcher or biometric focus, firing a glowing stream of flesh-searing polymer at a target.
spells.mechanics:
Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 4d4 Acid damage immediately and 2d4 Acid damage at the end of its next turn as the bio-solvent continues to dissolve armor plating and flesh. On a miss, the chemical splash still deals half of the initial damage (2d4 Acid damage) and no damage at the end of its next turn.
At Higher Levels: When cast using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d4 for both initial and delayed damage for each slot level above 2nd.

spells.name: Chem-Solvent Spray
spells.description: You vent a micro-pressurized stream of corrosive industrial chemical or toxic bio-reagent from a sub-dermal nozzle or wrist emitter toward one or two close targets.
spells.mechanics:
Choose one creature within range, or two creatures within range that are within 5 feet of each other. A target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 Acid damage.
At Higher Levels: The spell's damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).

spells.name: Bio-Nanite Overclock
components: (a tiny bio-nanite vial or Hoshi Biodyne medical chip)
spells.description: You broadcast an emergency cellular repair protocol that deploys micro-nanites into up to three allies' nervous systems, increasing their physical toughness and sealing minor tissue damage.
spells.mechanics:
Choose up to three creatures within range. Each target's hit point maximum and current hit points increase by 5 for the duration.
At Higher Levels: When cast using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the targets' hit points increase by an additional 5 for each slot level above 2nd.

spells.name: Sensor Perimeter Ping
components: (a micro-sensor node or optic wire spool)
spells.description: You deploy invisible optical laser tripwires and ultrasonic motion-sensor pings across a designated area, alerting your comms feed or HUD the moment an unauthorized signature breaks the perimeter.
spells.mechanics: Set a point within range and designate an area no larger than a 20-foot cube. Until the spell ends, an alarm alerts you whenever a Tiny or larger creature touches or enters the warded area. When casting, you can designate creatures that won't trigger the alarm. Choose whether the alarm is Mental (a private wireless ping sent to your neural feed up to 1 mile away) or Audible (a 60-foot piercing electronic klaxon chime).

spells.name: Sub-Dermal Flesh-Craft
spells.description: You execute an adaptive bio-reconstruction code or active optical-mesh cloak, altering your physical features, skin pigmentation, or sub-dermal biology on the fly.
spells.mechanics:
You assume a new form. When you cast the spell, choose one of the following options. While the spell lasts, you can use an action to end one option and gain the benefits of a different one:
Biometric Spoofing: You alter your physical appearance (facial structure, height, voice modulation, dermal color, hair, sex) to spoof cameras, facial recognition, and human observers. You gain advantage on Deep Fake (Deception) checks to maintain the disguise.
Aquatic Adaptive Sub-Dermal: You adapt your body to aquatic environments. You sprout gill-slits or bio-filters that allow you to breathe underwater, and webbed digits that grant a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.
High-Frequency Natural Augments: You sprout monomolecular claws, bone-spikes, or high-torque jaw teeth. Your unarmed strikes deal 1d6 Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage (your choice), count as magical weapon strikes, and gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls.

spells.name: Critter Subroutine Override
components: (a morsel of synth-kibble or an optic signal ping)
spells.description: You broadcast a pacification pulse or offer conditioned synth-kibble to suppress territorial hostility in a street critter, stray cyber-hound, or low-tier bio-drone.
spells.mechanics:
Choose a beast or bio-drone within range that has an Intelligence score of 3 or lower. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be Subliminally Overridden (Charmed) by you for the spell's duration. If you or one of your allies harms the target, the spell instantly ends.
At Higher Levels: When cast using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional beast or bio-drone for each slot level above 1st.

spells.name: Bio-Drone Data Relay
components: (a micro-data chip or optical tracking tag)
spells.description: You upload a brief encrypted message or audio clip into a Tiny street critter, mechanical sparrow, or micro-surveillance drone, routing it to deliver the payload across Neo-Tokyo's vertical layers.
spells.mechanics:
Target a Tiny beast or micro-drone within range. You specify a recipient and a general location. You speak a message of up to 25 words. The target travels toward the destination at a speed of roughly 50 miles per 24 hours for airborne targets or 25 miles per 24 hours for land targets. Upon reaching the target, it broadcasts the message in your voice, then resumes its normal behavior.
At Higher Levels: When cast using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the duration increases by 48 hours for each slot level above 2nd.

spells.name: Bio-Drone Swarm Reconfiguration
spells.description: You project a high-density genetic rewrite code or nanite restructuring field into surrounding allies, forcibly mutating their physical frames into apex bio-drones or heavy urban beasts.
spells.mechanics: Choose any number of willing creatures within range. You transform each target into a Large or smaller beast or bio-drone of Challenge Rating 4 or lower. You can choose different forms for different targets. On subsequent turns, you can use your action to transform affected targets into new beast forms. A target's game statistics are replaced by the chosen beast/bio-drone stat block, though it retains its alignment, personality, Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores.

spells.name: Cyber-Corpse Rigging
components: (a micro-actuator controller, servomotor rig, or neural override chip)
spells.description: You drive sub-dermal servomotors, wiring, and a crude neural governor into a corpse or skeletal frame, animating it into a loyal cyber-zombie or automated skeletal rig.
spells.mechanics:
Target a pile of bones or a humanoid corpse within range. Your spell rewires the remains, animating it as a Skeletal Rig (if targeting bones) or a Cyber-Zombie (if targeting a corpse). On each of your turns, you can use a bonus action to mentally command any construct created by this spell if the creature is within 60 feet. The construct obeys your mental commands for 24 hours.
At Higher Levels: When cast using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you animate or reassert control over two additional constructs for each slot level above 3rd.

spells.name: Automated Hardware Hijack
spells.description: You broadcast an explosive wireless override pulse that animates unattached urban hardware—street signs, vending machine panels, discarded engine blocks, or arcade chassis—granting them kinetic levitation and combat routines.
spells.mechanics:
Choose up to ten non-magical, unequipped objects within range that aren't being worn or carried. Each object animates, sprouting hard-light thrusters or kinetic actuators, and becomes a construct under your control until the spell ends.
Tiny: 1 object (HP: 20, AC: 18, Atk: +8, 1d4+4 Dmg)
Small: 1 object (HP: 25, AC: 16, Atk: +6, 1d8+2 Dmg)
Medium: 2 objects (HP: 40, AC: 13, Atk: +5, 2d6+1 Dmg)
Large: 4 objects (HP: 50, AC: 10, Atk: +6, 2d10+2 Dmg)
Huge: 8 objects (HP: 80, AC: 10, Atk: +8, 2d12+4 Dmg)
As a bonus action, you can mentally command any animated object within 120 feet to move and make a slam attack against a target.

spells.name: Bio-Organic Exclusion Field
components: (a micro-pulse generator chip or bio-sensor node)
spells.description: You project a high-frequency bio-dispersion field from your sub-dermal harness or focus, creating a 10-foot barrier that repels living organic matter and biological metahumans.
spells.mechanics: A 10-foot-radius barrier extends from you and moves with you as its center. Living creatures (humanoids, beasts, bio-drones, plant-critters) cannot pass or reach through the barrier. Constructs, Cyber-Zombies, and Skeletal Rigs are unaffected by the field. If a living creature is within 10 feet of you when you cast the spell, the field forces the creature back until it is outside the barrier. If you move so that an affected creature is forced to pass through the barrier, the spell instantly collapses.

spells.name: Null-Mana Damping Dome
components: (a high-density lead-alloy capacitor or Izanagi Grid damper node)
spells.description: You activate an ultra-high-density frequency dampener that neutralizes all local mana flow, astral energy, matrix magic subroutines, and active spell code within a 10-foot sphere centered on you.
spells.mechanics:
Within the 10-foot sphere, no spells can be cast, active magic and hacks are suppressed, and the magical properties of weapons and cyberware are temporarily disabled. 
Any active spell or magic effect targeting a creature or area inside the sphere is suppressed while inside it. 
Magical weapons, focuses, and enchanted cyberware function as mundane equivalents while within the dome. 
Summoned spirits, sprites, and magical constructs phase out of physical existence while inside the sphere.

spells.name: Subliminal Beacon / Repulsion Signal
components: (a broadcast frequency array or pheromone-infused bio-chip)
spells.description: You encode an overwhelming subconscious broadcasting frequency or pheromone profile into a location, object, or target, implanting an irresistible neural attraction or psychological terror toward a designated target category.
spells.mechanics:
Target a Huge or smaller object or location, and designate a specific creature type or metahuman heritage. Choose one of the following broadcast modes:
Repulsion: Affected targets coming within 120 feet of the beacon must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or suffer Threat-Lock (Frightened). While frightened, the creature must use its movement on each turn to move as far away from the beacon as possible.
Attraction: Affected targets coming within 120 feet of the beacon must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or suffer Subliminal Override (Charmed). While charmed, the target is compelled to approach the beacon and stay near it.

spells.name: Micro-Drone Optical Scanner
components: (a crystal micro-lens or optical sensor head)
spells.description: You deploy an invisible, floating micro-recon drone equipped with thermal optics, night vision, and a live HUD feed linked directly to your optic implants.
spells.mechanics: You create an invisible, floating optic sensor within range. The sensor has darkvision and thermal optics out to 30 feet, streaming visual and audio feeds directly into your neural HUD. As an action, you can move the sensor up to 30 feet in any direction. There is no limit to how far away from you the sensor can move, but it cannot pass through solid physical barriers. It can pass through small gaps, ventilation grates, and openings as small as 1 inch in diameter.

spells.name: Hard-Light Power-Glove
components: (an articulated servo-glove or hard-light emitter ring)
spells.description: You project a Large, glowing hard-light energy gauntlet or hydraulic kinetic force-arm that hovers in mid-air to grapple enemies, crush physical barriers, or shield you from incoming attacks.
spells.mechanics:
You project a Large hard-light gauntlet at an unoccupied space within range. The gauntlet has an AC of 20, Hit Points equal to your maximum Hit Points, a Strength score of 26 (+8), and a Dexterity score of 10 (+0). On the turn you cast it, and as a bonus action on subsequent turns, you can command the gauntlet to perform Clenched Strike (4d12 Force damage), Force Shove, Grasp & Crush (2d6 + spell modifier Force damage), or Aegis Shield (+2 AC half cover).
At Higher Levels: When cast using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, Clenched Strike damage increases by 2d12 and Grasp & Crush damage increases by 2d6 for each slot level above 5th.

spells.name: Biometric Firewall Lockout
components: (a biometric lock-gel cartridge or encrypted key-card)
spells.description: You apply an encrypted digital lock and high-density biometric security script onto an entryway, safe door, or computer terminal.
spells.mechanics: You securely lock a door, window, gate, chest, or digital terminal. You and creatures you designate can open the object normally. You can also set a biometric password or cipher. The DC to break the lock or pick it increases by 10.

spells.name: Monomolecular Energy Blade
spells.description: You materialize a floating, three-foot-long blade of pure monomolecular plasma and hard-light energy that slices through armor and cyberware.
spells.mechanics: Create a floating energy blade within range. When the blade appears, you can make a melee spell attack against a target within 5 feet of it. On a hit, the target takes 3d10 Force damage. As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the blade up to 20 feet and repeat the attack.

spells.name: Firmware Signature Mask
components: (a silk cloth or optic dampening gel)
spells.description: You alter the digital signature, magical aura, or cyberware telemetry of an item or target to fool security scanners and spell detectors.
spells.mechanics: You alter how the target appears to detection spells and security sensors. You can mask an item's magical or technological aura, make a magical item register as mundane, or alter its alignment signature.

spells.name: Astral-Net Projection
components: (a set of jacinth crystals worth 1,000gp in a silver casing)
spells.description: You decouple your consciousness and spirit body from your physical form, projecting your soul into the Astral Plane and the deepest layer of the global Matrix grid.
spells.mechanics: You and up to eight willing creatures project your astral bodies into the Astral Plane. Your physical body falls unconscious and enters stasis. Your astral body possesses your stats and equipment.

spells.name: Predictive Data Analytics
components: (specially marked digital coins or neural dice)
spells.description: You feed real-time atmospheric data, corporate market trends, and probability algorithms into your deck to predict the short-term outcome of a specific action.
spells.mechanics: You receive an omen from your analytics deck regarding the results of a specific course of action you plan to take within the next 30 minutes: Weal (good), Woe (bad), Weal and Woe (both), or Nothing.

spells.name: Consciousness Uplink Routine
components: (an Awakened resin module or KAMI neural chip worth 1,000gp)
spells.description: You implant a self-aware synthetic soul routine or spirit-code into an un-awakened urban critter, plant, or autonomous drone, granting it sapience.
spells.mechanics: Target a beast, plant, or construct with an Intelligence of 3 or lower. The target gains an Intelligence score of 10 and the ability to speak one language you know. It is Charmed by you for 30 days.

spells.name: Subliminal Glitch Injection
spells.description: You beam a subtle neural glitch or micro-malware ping into up to three targets, causing optic stutters and muscle twitches that throw off their aim.
spells.mechanics:
Up to three targets within range must make a Charisma saving throw. Whenever a target that fails this save makes an attack roll or saving throw before the spell ends, it must subtract 1d4 from the roll.
At Higher Levels: You can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

spells.name: Matrix Isolation Quarantine
spells.description: You force a target's consciousness or physical form into an isolated, pocket digital quarantine server, removing them from the battlefield.
spells.mechanics: Target a creature within range. It must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be banished to a harmless digital quarantine server. While there, the target is Incapacitated. If the target is native to a different plane or digital realm, it returns to its home plane on a failed save.

spells.name: Sub-Dermal Kinetic Weave
components: (a patch of hardened reptile scale or Kevlar thread)
spells.description: You temporarily harden a target's skin or clothing with flexible carbon-mesh and sub-dermal kinetic plating.
spells.mechanics: Touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor. Until the spell ends, the target's skin hardens and its AC cannot be less than 16.

spells.name: High-Priority Signal Broadcast
spells.description: You broadcast an uplifting motivational comms feed and trauma-suppression frequency to stabilize allies during intense combat.
spells.mechanics: For the duration, allies within 30 feet have advantage on Wisdom saving throws and death saving throws, and regain the maximum possible hit points from any healing.

spells.name: Black ICE Corruption Malware
spells.description: You touch a creature and upload a malicious Black ICE payload directly into its nerve cluster or cyber-ports.
spells.mechanics: Touch a target. It must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, choose one effect: disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls using one attribute; disadvantage on attack rolls against you; or taking 1d8 Necrotic/Psychic damage at the start of its turns.

spells.name: High-Voltage Cable Swarm
spells.description: Writhing bundles of high-voltage copper cabling and monofilament wires erupt from the ground, grabbing and shocking enemies.
spells.mechanics: A 20-foot square area within range turns into difficult terrain filled with writhing cables. Creatures starting their turn in the area take 3d6 Bludgeoning/Lightning damage and must make a Dexterity save or be Restrained.

spells.name: Hard-Light Razor Grid
spells.description: You project a massive wall of hard-light razor beams and spinning laser cutters across the field.
spells.mechanics: You create a wall of razor-sharp energy up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick. Any creature passing through the wall takes 6d10 Slashing/Force damage.

spells.name: Neural Precision Boost
components: (a drop of holy oil or focus ping)
spells.description: You upload a tactical targeting enhancement into up to three allies, sharpening their focus and reaction speed.
spells.mechanics:
Up to three allies within range add a 1d4 bonus to their attack rolls and saving throws for the duration.
At Higher Levels: Target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

spells.name: Cellular Decay Beam
spells.description: You blast a target with a high-intensity necrotic radiation beam that rots organic tissue and breaks down cellular bonds.
spells.mechanics: Target a creature within range. It must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d8 Necrotic damage on a failure, or half on a success.

spells.name: Optical Glitch / Acoustic Jammer
spells.description: You inject a targeted optic glitch or audio deafening code into a creature's sensory implants or nervous system.
spells.mechanics: Target a creature within range. It must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or become Blinded or Deafened (your choice) for the duration. It can repeat the save at the end of each turn.

spells.name: Phase-Shift Glitch
spells.description: Your body rapidly glitters and phase-shifts between physical reality and the local digital grid, making you unpredictable to target.
spells.mechanics: At the end of your turn, roll a d20. On an 11 or higher, you vanish from your current plane into the Ethereal/Digital Plane. At the start of your next turn, you reappear in an unoccupied space within 10 feet.

spells.name: Holographic Optical Camouflage
spells.description: You project an active optical camouflage shimmer around your body, blurring your position to observers.
spells.mechanics: Any creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against you. An attacker is immune to this effect if it doesn't rely on sight or can see through illusions.

spells.name: High-Voltage Tracker Strike
spells.description: Your next weapon hit discharges a surging high-voltage shock and tags the target with a luminous, tracking signal.
spells.mechanics: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack, it takes an extra 2d6 Radiant/Lightning damage and sheds bright light in a 5-foot radius. It cannot become invisible.

spells.name: Sub-Dermal Flame-Venter
spells.description: You vent a searing sheet of liquid napalm or superheated plasma in a 15-foot cone from your sub-dermal nozzles.
spells.mechanics:
Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 Fire damage on a failure, or half on a success.
At Higher Levels: Damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st.

spells.name: Orbital Plasma Strike
spells.description: You ping a satellite or sky-arcology relay to paint a target area, unleashing torrential lightning arcs and plasma bursts.
spells.mechanics: A storm cloud or orbital target laser forms in a 60-foot cylinder. As an action, you call down a bolt of lightning, dealing 3d10 Lightning damage to creatures in a 5-foot radius on a failed Dexterity save.

spells.name: Subliminal Neural Pacifier
spells.description: You emit a calming neurological frequency that suppresses intense aggression and adrenaline surges in nearby targets.
spells.mechanics: Suppress strong emotions in humanoids in a 20-foot sphere. Targets failing a Charisma save lose hostile intentions and immunity to Charm/Frightened.

spells.name: Arc-Discharge Network
components: (a bit of fur and an amber rod)
spells.description: You discharge a massive high-voltage arc at a primary target that leaps through up to three secondary targets in a chaining arc.
spells.mechanics: A bolt of lightning strikes a target within range, dealing 10d8 Lightning damage on a failed Dexterity save. Three secondary bolts jump to targets within 30 feet of the first target.

spells.name: Subliminal Override
spells.description: You broadcast a subtle subliminal frequency that makes a target humanoid view you as a trusted friend and ally.
spells.mechanics: Target a humanoid. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (with advantage if in combat) or be Charmed by you for 1 hour.

spells.name: Necrotic Signal Freeze
spells.description: You project a ghostly necrotic data feed that grips a target with chilling cold and suppresses its cellular healing.
spells.mechanics: Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Necrotic damage and cannot regain hit points until the start of your next turn.

spells.name: Bio-Nanite Liquefaction Field
spells.description: A wave of flesh-consuming bio-nanites erupts in a 60-foot sphere, liquefying biological matter.
spells.mechanics: All creatures in a 60-foot-radius sphere must make a Constitution save, taking 8d6 Necrotic damage on a failure, or half on a success.

spells.name: Remote Drone Feeds
spells.description: You deploy an invisible sensor link to remotely view or listen to a familiar location anywhere within range.
spells.mechanics: Create an invisible sensor at a familiar or described location within 1 mile. You can see or hear through the sensor as if you were present.

spells.name: Replicant Biomass Vats
spells.description: You grow an inert, identical replicant clone of a target inside a bio-engineering vat, ready to receive their consciousness upon death.
spells.mechanics: You grow a duplicate clone body over 120 days. If the original creature dies, its soul/consciousness transfers to the clone body instantly.

spells.name: Sector 17 Neuro-Toxin Vapor
spells.description: You vent a dense, greenish neuro-toxic gas cloud from Sector 17 that chokes and dissolves living tissue.
spells.mechanics: Create a 20-foot-radius sphere of yellow-green fog. A creature starting its turn in the fog takes 5d8 Poison damage on a failed Constitution save.

spells.name: Strobe Light Flashbang
spells.description: A sudden burst of multi-colored strobe lasers and flashbang lights blinds surrounding enemies.
spells.mechanics: Roll 6d10; the total is how many Hit Points of creatures in a 15-foot cone this spell can affect, causing them to become Blinded.

spells.name: Subconscious Neural Override
spells.description: You issue a single, authoritative neural command that forces a target to execute a specific 1-word action.
spells.mechanics: Target a creature. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or follow a 1-word command (e.g. Approach, Drop, Halt, Flee) on its next turn.

spells.name: Deep-Net Matrix Query
spells.description: You contact an extra-dimensional Matrix core or powerful corporate AI to ask up to six direct questions.
spells.mechanics: Contact a powerful AI or deity to ask up to six questions that can be answered with a yes or no.

spells.name: Ley-Line Environmental Ping
spells.description: You ping the local environmental ley lines and urban grid to learn facts about the surrounding district.
spells.mechanics: Gain knowledge of the surrounding territory up to 3 miles (terrain, water, creatures, threat levels).

spells.name: Universal Neural Translator
spells.description: Your neural interface translates all spoken and written languages, digital codes, and dialects in real time.
spells.mechanics: You understand the literal meaning of any spoken language you hear or written text you read.

spells.name: Behavioral Routing Override
spells.description: You force a target creature to move in a specific direction on its turn, overriding its motor controls.
spells.mechanics: Target a creature. It must succeed on a Wisdom save or use its movement on each turn to move in a direction you specify.

spells.name: Liquid Nitrogen Venter
spells.description: You blast a massive 60-foot cone of sub-zero liquid nitrogen and cryogenic fog from your vents.
spells.mechanics: Creatures in a 60-foot cone must make a Constitution save, taking 8d8 Cold damage on a failure, or half on a success.

spells.name: Neural Feedback Loop
spells.description: You flood a target's neural network with conflicting sensory data, causing erratic actions and confusion.
spells.mechanics: Creatures in a 10-foot sphere must make a Wisdom save or act randomly on their turn according to a d10 roll table.

spells.name: Bio-Drone Deployment Routine
spells.description: You summon a pack of bio-engineered beasts or combat drones to assist you in combat.
spells.mechanics: Summon beasts/bio-drones of CR 2 or lower (or multiple lower CR beasts) that obey your commands.

spells.name: Astral Entity Manifestation
spells.description: You summon an astral spirit-entity or high-tier celestial AI construct to fight by your side.
spells.mechanics: Summon a celestial or powerful astral spirit of CR 4 or lower that obeys your commands.

spells.name: Elemental Ley-Line Manifestation
spells.description: You summon a massive elemental avatar from local ley lines (Fire, Water, Earth, or Air).
spells.mechanics: Summon an elemental of CR 5 or lower that obeys your verbal commands.

spells.name: Spirit-Critter Summons
spells.description: You summon a high-tier spirit critter or fey-born bio-drone from Kitsune-cho.
spells.mechanics: Summon a fey/spirit beast of CR 6 or lower that obeys your commands.

spells.name: Sub-Elemental Micro-Manifestation
spells.description: You manifest up to four minor elemental spirits or micro-drones from local power lines.
spells.mechanics: Summon up to 4 minor elementals of CR 1/2 or lower.

spells.name: Urban Spirit-Critter Swarm
spells.description: You call forth a swarm of urban spirit beasts or micro-drones to harass your enemies.
spells.mechanics: Summon fey/spirit beasts of CR 2 or lower.

spells.name: Deep Matrix AI Link
spells.description: You link your deck directly to an extra-dimensional AI entity in the deep Matrix to gain profound knowledge.
spells.mechanics: Make an Intelligence check to ask an extra-dimensional entity 5 questions. On a failed save, suffer psychic damage and insanity.

spells.name: Cyber-Infection Protocol
spells.description: You infect a target with a virulent bio-toxin or hardware-eating flesh virus upon touch.
spells.mechanics: Make a melee spell attack to infect a target with one of 6 debilitating bio-diseases on a failed Constitution save.

spells.name: Automated Trigger Subroutine
spells.description: You encode a backup spell script that triggers automatically when specific environmental conditions are met.
spells.mechanics: Set a trigger condition and cast a 5th-level or lower spell that activates instantly when the condition occurs.

spells.name: Hard-Light Perpetual Beacon
spells.description: You touch an object to create a permanent, heatless hard-light flame or LED beacon.
spells.mechanics: Touch an object to make it emit bright light in a 20-foot radius permanently without producing heat.

spells.name: Hydro-Pump Regulation
components: (a drop of water and a pinch of dust)
spells.description: You manipulate water currents, flood levels, or hydro-pumps in a 100-foot area.
spells.mechanics: Control water in a 100-foot cube (Redirect Flow, Part Water, Raise/Lower Water Level, Flood).

spells.name: Atmospheric Arcology Regulator
spells.description: You hack into local arcology weather regulators to alter rain, fog, temperature, and wind across a 5-mile area.
spells.mechanics: Change local weather conditions (temperature, precipitation, wind speed) over an 8-hour period.

spells.name: Code-Interrupt Firewall
spells.description: You execute an instantaneous firewall ping that interrupts an enemy spell or hack as it is being cast.
spells.mechanics: Interrupt a spell being cast within 60 feet. Spells of 3rd level or lower automatically fail. Higher level spells require an ability check.

spells.name: Synth-Ramen & Hydro-Synthesizer
spells.description: You materialize 45 pounds of nourishing synth-ramen and 30 gallons of purified water.
spells.mechanics: Create 45 pounds of food and 30 gallons of fresh water, enough to sustain up to 15 humanoids for 24 hours.

spells.name: Atmospheric Moisture Collector
spells.description: You create up to 10 gallons of clean water, or drain water from a 10-foot cube.
spells.mechanics: Create 10 gallons of clean water in an open container, or destroy water in a 10-foot cube.

spells.name: Advanced Cyber-Zombie Fabrication
components: (a clay pot filled with grave dirt and black onyx)
spells.description: You fabricate advanced cyber-zombies, ghoul-cyborgs, or heavy skeletal combat rigs.
spells.mechanics: Animate up to three corpses as ghouls/cyber-zombies under your control.

spells.name: Hard-Light Materializer
spells.description: You materialize non-magical physical objects out of hard-light energy and solid-state data.
spells.mechanics: Materialize an object of vegetable, mineral, or metallic composition up to a 5-foot cube.

spells.name: Rapid Bio-Nanite Patch
spells.description: You inject a rapid surge of healing bio-nanites into a target to instantly seal wounds.
spells.mechanics: A creature you touch regains Hit Points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

spells.name: Floating LED Micro-Drones
spells.description: You deploy up to four glowing LED micro-drones that illuminate dark alleyways.
spells.mechanics: Create up to 4 torch-sized lights that move at your command.

spells.name: Optical Smoke & Chaff Spray
spells.description: You deploy a 15-foot sphere of pitch-black optical smoke and metallic radar-chaff.
spells.mechanics: Create a 15-foot-radius sphere of magical darkness that blocks vision and darkvision.

spells.name: Thermal-Optic Augmentation
spells.description: You upgrade a target's optical implants with 60-foot thermal and low-light vision.
spells.mechanics: Grant a willing target Darkvision out to 60 feet for 8 hours.

spells.name: High-Lumen Flare Beacon
spells.description: You project a 60-foot radius sphere of intense daylight to dispel darkness and optical smoke.
spells.mechanics: Create bright light in a 60-foot radius that dispels magical darkness of 3rd level or lower.

spells.name: Emergency Defibrillator Bio-Stasis
spells.description: You prime an internal emergency defibrillator that prevents a target from dying when taking lethal damage.
spells.mechanics: The first time the target would drop to 0 Hit Points, it drops to 1 Hit Point instead.

spells.name: Time-Delayed Plasma Charges
spells.description: You place a glowing, time-delayed plasma bead that detonates in a massive firestorm.
spells.mechanics: Create a glowing bead that detonates after 1 minute (or upon command) dealing 12d6 Fire damage in a 20-foot sphere, increasing by 1d6 per round stored.

spells.name: Virtual Data-Vault Construction
spells.description: You conjure a doorway into a private extra-dimensional virtual data vault.
spells.mechanics: Manifest a doorway leading to a 30-foot extra-dimensional room.

spells.name: Threat & Malice Scanner
spells.description: Your optics scan the area for extra-dimensional entities, corporate threats, and malice signatures.
spells.mechanics: Sensing the presence of aberrations, celestials, dragons, elementals, fey, fiends, or undead within 60 feet.

spells.name: Mana & Signal Scanner
spells.description: Your optics scan for magical code, spell effects, and active signal transmissions.
spells.mechanics: Sense the presence of magic within 30 feet and learn its school.

spells.name: Bio-Tox & Pathogen Analyzer
spells.description: Your sensors identify poisons, bio-toxins, and diseases within 30 feet.
spells.mechanics: Detect and identify poisons, venom, and disease within 30 feet.

spells.name: Neural Mind Probe
spells.description: You probe a target's neural feed to read surface thoughts or probe deeper memories.
spells.mechanics: Read surface thoughts of a target, or probe deeper thoughts on a failed Wisdom save.

spells.name: Phase-Shift Teleport
spells.description: You phase-shift your physical form through the Matrix grid to teleport up to 500 feet.
spells.mechanics: Teleport yourself and up to 500 lbs of gear/allies to a location within 500 feet.

spells.name: Holographic Skin-Spoofer
spells.description: You project a holographic disguise over your clothing and physical appearance.
spells.mechanics: Change your visual appearance including clothing, armor, and weapons for 1 hour.

spells.name: Particle Disassembly Beam
spells.description: A green particle-disassembly beam disintegrates target matter into fine dust.
spells.mechanics: Deals 10d6+40 Force damage on a failed Dexterity save. If this reduces the target to 0 HP, it is disintegrated.

spells.name: Malicious Entity Purge
spells.description: You purge extra-dimensional entities, possessors, and rogue spirits from a target.
spells.mechanics: Protect a target from extra-planar creatures, or banish/unpossess a target.

spells.name: Code Scrub & Firewall Purge
spells.description: You run a purge script that cancels active spell code and hacks on a target.
spells.mechanics: End spells of 3rd level or lower on a target. Requires an ability check for higher level spells.

spells.name: Quantum Predictive Analytics
spells.description: You execute a deep quantum simulation to gain advice regarding a goal within 7 days.
spells.mechanics: Receive a truthful advice snippet regarding a specific goal or event within 7 days.

spells.name: High-Voltage Combat Coating
spells.description: Your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 Radiant/Lightning damage.
spells.mechanics: Your weapon strikes deal an additional 1d4 Radiant damage for the duration.

spells.name: Subliminal Master Broadcast
spells.description: You broadcast a deafening sonic and neural command that stuns or kills weak targets.
spells.mechanics: Creatures within 30 feet take effects based on their current HP (deafened, blinded, stunned, or instantly killed).

spells.name: Bio-Drone Master Override
spells.description: You force a total neural takeover of a beast or bio-drone.
spells.mechanics: Take total control of a beast on a failed Wisdom save.

spells.name: Neural Core Master Hijack
spells.description: You force a total neural takeover of any creature or boss target.
spells.mechanics: Take total control of any creature on a failed Wisdom save.

spells.name: Subliminal Neural Hijack
spells.description: You force a total neural takeover of a humanoid target.
spells.mechanics: Take total control of a humanoid on a failed Wisdom save.

spells.name: Virtual Reality Simulation Injection
spells.description: You send a tailored holographic VR dream/nightmare feed to a sleeping target anywhere in Neo-Tokyo.
spells.mechanics: Inject a virtual reality dream or nightmare into a sleeping target, dealing 3d6 Psychic damage and preventing rest benefits.

spells.name: Micro-Ecology Manipulator
spells.description: You manipulate minor urban nature effects—blooming cyber-flora, predicting weather, or lighting torches.
spells.mechanics: Create minor botanical effects, predict local weather, or light small fires.

spells.name: Seismic Structural Breaker
spells.description: You trigger intense seismic shockwaves that collapse structures and knock enemies prone in a 100-foot area.
spells.mechanics: Triggers intense seismic ground tremors in a 100-foot radius, knocking creatures prone and damaging structures.

spells.name: Ghost-Byte Beam
spells.description: You fire a crackling beam of raw matrix code and electrical force.
spells.mechanics: Make a ranged spell attack dealing 1d10 Force damage. Fires additional beams at 5th, 11th, and 17th level.

spells.name: Bio-Algorithmic Overclock
spells.description: You overclock a target's physical or mental attribute for 1 hour.
spells.mechanics: Grant advantage on ability checks for one chosen ability score (STR, DEX, CON, INT, WIS, CHA) plus extra situational perks.

spells.name: Nanite Biomass Modifier
spells.description: You expand or shrink a target's biomass using nanite density shifts.
spells.mechanics: Enlarge or reduce a creature's size category by one step, altering its weight and damage rolls (+1d4 or -1d4).

spells.name: High-Tensile Cable Snare
spells.description: High-tensile wire snares and carbon vines erupt in a 20-foot square, restraining targets.
spells.mechanics: Creates difficult terrain in a 20-foot square. Creatures entering must succeed on a Strength save or be Restrained.

spells.name: Subliminal Broadcast Hype
spells.description: You broadcast a mesmerizing hype track that captivates targets and holds their attention.
spells.mechanics: Targets failing a Wisdom save have disadvantage on Perception checks to notice anyone other than you.

spells.name: Phase-Shift Infiltration Protocol
components: (a micro-phase capacitor or quantum frequency key)
spells.description: You decouple your physical atoms and digital signature from baseline physical space, shifting into the border zone between the physical world and the Matrix grid.
spells.mechanics: You enter the border region of the Ethereal / Digital Plane for the duration. You can see and hear the physical plane, but everything looks gray and digital. While phase-shifted, you can move through physical objects and creatures, and can only affect or be affected by other phase-shifted entities.

spells.name: Adrenaline Overclock Routine
spells.description: You trigger an emergency neural impulse that floods your muscle actuators with high-voltage charge, doubling your movement speed.
spells.mechanics: When you cast this spell, and as a bonus action on each of your turns until the spell ends, you can take the Dash action.

spells.name: Ocular Cyber-Blight
spells.description: Your optics flash with a malicious virus feed that infects a target's brain-computer interface, inflicting gruesome physical and visual glitches.
spells.mechanics: Target one creature within range. It must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be affected by one of the following glitches for the duration (your choice): Glitched Optics (Blinded), Terrified System Lockout (Frightened), Neural Tremors (Disadvantage on attacks/checks), or Bio-Drain (takes 2d8 Necrotic damage when it acts).

spells.name: Nanite 3D-Fabrication Array
components: (raw synth-polymer, metal alloy, or scrap electronics)
spells.description: You deploy industrial nanite swarms to instantly break down scrap materials and 3D-fabricate complex tools, gear, or barricades.
spells.mechanics: You convert raw materials into a finished product of the same material (e.g. metal scrap into a door or weapon). You cannot fabricate items requiring high-precision microchips unless you supply the electronics.

spells.name: Bio-Luminescent Target Marker
spells.description: You paint a 20-foot cube with a high-visibility holographic laser grid and bio-luminescent tracking chaff, highlighting hidden targets.
spells.mechanics: Each object or creature in a 20-foot cube within range must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be outlined in glowing neon light. Any attack roll against an outlined target has advantage if the attacker can see it, and affected targets cannot benefit from stealth or invisibility.

spells.name: Cyber-Hound Security Sentry
components: (a silver whistle or biometric beacon tag)
spells.description: You summon a phantom hard-light cyber-hound that guards a designated perimeter and alerts you to invisible or stealth intruders.
spells.mechanics: Manifest an invisible cyber-hound guard at a point within range. The hound has True Sight out to 30 feet, darkvision to 60 feet, and can detect stealth or invisible creatures. If an intruder approaches within 30 feet, the hound barks loudly and can bite the target (+8 to hit, 4d8 Piercing damage).

spells.name: Bio-Synthetic Cell Injector
components: (a drop of synthetic blood or Hoshi Biodyne cell ampoule)
spells.description: You inject a dose of synthetic blood-platelets and temporary bio-gel, bolstering your physical frame with a buffer of temporary vitality.
spells.mechanics:
You gain 1d4 + 4 temporary hit points for the duration.
At Higher Levels: When cast using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the temporary hit points increase by 5 for each slot level above 1st.

spells.name: Neural Terror Feedback
spells.description: You broadcast a harrowing psychological panic frequency that projects horrific hallucinations of corporate execution squads directly into enemies' optic nerves.
spells.mechanics: Each creature in a 30-foot cone must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or drop whatever it is holding and become Threat-Locked (Frightened) for the duration. While frightened, a target must take the Dash action and move away from you on each of its turns.

spells.name: Kinetic Inertia Dampener
spells.description: You activate micro-air-thrusters or sub-dermal gravity dampeners on up to five falling creatures, neutralizing kinetic impact damage.
spells.mechanics: Choose up to five falling creatures within range. A target's rate of descent slows to 60 feet per round until the spell ends. If the creature lands before the spell ends, it takes no falling damage and lands on its feet.

spells.name: System Code Scrambler
spells.description: You execute a permanent neural code scramble that wipes a target's technical aptitude, spell access, and higher cognitive faculties.
spells.mechanics: Target a creature within range. It must make a Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, the creature's Intelligence and Charisma scores drop to 1. The creature cannot cast spells, activate cyberware, communicate intelligibly, or understand language until cured by a High-Priority System Purge.

spells.name: Recon Drone Familiar
components: (10gp worth of micro-circuitry and copper wire)
spells.description: You assemble or summon a compact autonomous recon drone or spirit-critter that links to your neural feed and acts as your field scout.
spells.mechanics: You gain the services of a familiar (a micro-drone or spirit animal). The familiar acts independently, but obeys your commands. As an action, you can see through its optics and hear through its audio sensors up to 100 feet away.

spells.name: Cyber-Steed Deployment
spells.description: You summon an autonomous cybernetic mount or heavy combat bike from a local transport grid.
spells.mechanics: You summon a loyal, cybernetically enhanced mount (such as a cyber-horse or heavy street bike). The mount has the statistics of a riding horse, warhorse, or camel (or similar vehicle/beast) and serves as a loyal mount in combat.

spells.name: GPS Route Algorithm
components: (a set of topo-maps or navigation chip)
spells.description: Your deck calculates the optimal physical or digital route to any specified location, bypass, or secret objective in Neo-Tokyo.
spells.mechanics: Specify a location on the same plane. For the duration, you know the shortest, safest physical route to that destination and automatically bypass natural hazards or navigation dead-ends.

spells.name: Automated Hazard Sweep
spells.description: Your HUD scans the surrounding 20-foot area for physical booby traps, laser tripwires, pressure plates, and malicious malware.
spells.mechanics: You sense the presence and nature of any trap within 120 feet that is within line of sight, including mechanical traps, landmines, cyber-glitch tripwires, and security sensors.

spells.name: Bio-Disassembly Neural Beam
spells.description: You point your finger and release a jet-black ray of concentrated necrotic radiation that instantly disintegrates organic tissue.
spells.mechanics: Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 8d12 + 20 Necrotic damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, its physical body is instantly dissolved into a pile of gray chemical ash.

spells.name: High-Voltage Plasma Arc
spells.description: You launch a streak of plasma or high-voltage energy from your palm emitter or firearm focus at a target.
spells.mechanics:
Make a ranged spell attack against a target within range. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Fire/Lightning damage.
Scaling: The damage increases by 1d10 at 5th level (2d10), 11th level (3d10), and 17th level (4d10).

spells.name: Thermal & Reactive Shielding
components: (a piece of phosphorus or ice crystal)
spells.description: You envelop your body in a high-voltage plasma barrier or super-cooled cryogenic aura that damages attackers upon physical contact.
spells.mechanics: Choose Flame Shield (Fire resistance, attackers within 5 feet take 2d8 Fire damage when hitting you in melee) or Cryo Shield (Cold resistance, attackers take 2d8 Cold damage).

spells.name: Orbital Plasma Bombardment
spells.description: You paint a location with an orbital target laser, calling down a catastrophic column of fire and raw plasma from a sky-arcology weapon platform.
spells.mechanics: Each creature in a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range must make a Dexterity save, taking 20d6 Fire/Force damage on a failure, or half on a success.

spells.name: Plasma Detonation Sphere
spells.description: You launch a glowing thermite-gel bead that detonates into a roaring 20-foot-radius sphere of white-hot plasma fire.
spells.mechanics:
Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a target point must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 Fire damage on a failure, or half on a success.
At Higher Levels: Damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.

spells.name: Monomolecular Heat Blade
spells.description: You ignite a three-foot blade of superheated plasma that extends from your wrist focus or hilt.
spells.mechanics: You evoke a fiery blade in your hand. You can make a melee spell attack with the blade dealing 3d6 Fire damage on a hit. The blade emits bright light in a 10-foot radius.

spells.name: Orbital Precision Strike
spells.description: A radiant column of satellite energy and searing plasma slams down from orbit, vaporizing physical structures.
spells.mechanics: A vertical column of light 10 feet in radius and 40 feet high deals 4d6 Fire damage and 4d6 Radiant damage to creatures failing a Dexterity save.

spells.name: Plasma Geysers
spells.description: You conjure a floating, super-heated plasma orb that rolls across the battlefield, scorching enemies.
spells.mechanics: A 5-foot-diameter sphere of fire appears within range. As a bonus action, you can move it up to 30 feet. Creatures touching the sphere take 2d6 Fire damage on a failed Dexterity save.

spells.name: Cybernetic Petrification Virus
components: (a chip of solid concrete or stone)
spells.description: You upload a brutal nano-petrification virus into a creature's bloodstream, turning its organic flesh into solid gray concrete.
spells.mechanics: Target a creature within range. It must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it is Restrained as its flesh hardens. If it fails three saving throws, it is permanently turned to solid stone/concrete.

spells.name: Repulsor Cargo Disk
spells.description: You project a floating, horizontal repulsor energy disk that carries heavy gear or wounded allies behind you.
spells.mechanics: Creates a circular repulsor field 3 feet in diameter that floats 3 feet above the ground. It can hold up to 500 pounds and follows 20 feet behind you.

spells.name: Repulsor Thruster Flight
spells.description: You activate sub-dermal repulsor thrusters or hard-light wings, granting a target high-speed aerial flight.
spells.mechanics: A willing creature you touch gains a flying speed of 60 feet for the duration.

spells.name: Acid Fog Chemical Venter
spells.description: You deploy a 20-foot-radius sphere of corrosive chemical acid fog and heavy smog that obscures vision and dissolves eyes.
spells.mechanics: Create a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog that heavily obscures the area. Wind of 10 mph or greater disperses it.

spells.name: District Security Lockdown
spells.description: You lock down a building or district perimeter with biometric scanners, laser grids, and automatic turrets.
spells.mechanics: Ward an area up to 20,000 square feet with security measures (locked doors, fog, web snares, alarm pings).

spells.name: Hard-Light Laser Cage
spells.description: You project an impenetrable cube or cage of hard-light laser beams around a target.
spells.mechanics: Traps a target inside an indestructible laser cage or solid box. Spells and physical attacks cannot pass through.

spells.name: Quantum Predictive Reflexes
spells.description: Your deck streams future probability threads directly into your optic HUD, making you immune to surprise and predicting enemy moves.
spells.mechanics: For the duration, the target cannot be surprised, has advantage on all attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws, and attackers have disadvantage on attacks against it.

spells.name: Neural Restraint Override
spells.description: You upload an anti-restraint code that renders a target immune to paralysis, mag-cuffs, slow effects, and water drag.
spells.mechanics: Target creature is immune to paralysis, movement speed reductions, non-magical restraints, and underwater movement penalties.

spells.name: Cryogenic Blast Sphere
components: (a glass globe filled with liquid nitrogen)
spells.description: A 60-foot-radius sphere detonates with flash-freezing liquid nitrogen and super-cooled shards of ice.
spells.mechanics: Deals 10d6 Cold damage to creatures in a 60-foot sphere on a failed Constitution save, or half on a success.

spells.name: Aerosolized Bio-Gaseous Form
spells.description: You convert a willing target's physical biomass into a floating cloud of aerosolized mist and nanites.
spells.mechanics: Target transforms into a misty cloud with a fly speed of 10 feet, gaining resistance to non-magical damage and immunity to poison.

spells.name: Matrix Portal Breach
spells.description: You tear open an inter-dimensional Matrix breach linking two distant points or deep server nodes across the globe.
spells.mechanics: Opens a two-way portal between your location and a specified destination on another plane or distant node.

spells.name: Biometric Command Firmware
spells.description: You implant a long-term behavioral command chip into a target, forcing it to complete a long-term task.
spells.mechanics: Implant a command into a target on a failed Wisdom save. The target takes 5d10 Psychic damage each day it acts directly against the command.

spells.name: Cryo-Stasis Preservative
components: (a pinch of salt and a copper piece)
spells.description: You coat a corpse in cryo-stasis foam, extending the time window for organ harvesting or revival.
spells.mechanics: Protects a corpse from decay and extends the time limit on resurrecting/reviving the target by 10 days.

spells.name: Bio-Drone Mutagen Exposure
spells.description: You unleash a mutagenic cloud that mutates surrounding street insects into massive bio-drones.
spells.mechanics: Transforms up to ten centipedes, spiders, or insects into giant variants under your command.

spells.name: Subliminal Silver-Tongue Protocol
spells.description: Your voice modulation and persuasion algorithms guarantee success in corporate boardroom negotiations.
spells.mechanics: Whenever you make a Charisma check for the duration, treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

spells.name: Null-Mana Damping Barrier
spells.description: An impenetrable 10-foot sphere of anti-magic energy isolates you from all incoming spell code and hacks.
spells.mechanics: Creates an impenetrable 10-foot sphere around you that completely blocks spells of 5th level or lower from entering.

spells.name: Mag-Lock Trap / Sensor Glyph
spells.description: You etch a hidden digital glyph or explosive mag-trap onto a surface that detonates when triggered.
spells.mechanics: Inscribe a rune that triggers an explosion (5d8 damage), spell effect, or alarm ping when an unauthorized creature touches it.

spells.name: Synth-Berry Nutrient Capsules
spells.description: You synthesize up to ten nutrient-dense synth-pills that restore health and satisfy hunger.
spells.mechanics: Creates up to 10 synth-pills. Eating a pill restores 1 Hit Point and provides nourishment for a full day.

spells.name: Conductive Friction Lubricant
spells.description: You slick a 10-foot square with conductive industrial oil, causing enemies to slip and fall prone.
spells.mechanics: Slicks a 10-foot square. Creatures walking through must succeed on a Dexterity save or fall Prone.

spells.name: Hard-Light Thermo-Optic Stealth Cloak
spells.description: You bend light and thermal signatures around a target, making them completely invisible even when attacking.
spells.mechanics: Target becomes invisible for the duration. Attacking or casting a spell does not break the invisibility.

spells.name: Bio-System Purge Script
spells.description: You run a deep system purge script that cures diseases, neutralizes toxins, and removes curses/paralysis.
spells.mechanics: Ends all debilitating conditions, curses, reduced ability scores, or max HP reductions on a target.

spells.name: Aegis Hard-Light Sentry
spells.description: You manifest a Large hard-light Aegis security sentry that strikes any enemies entering its zone.
spells.mechanics: Creates a Large hovering sentry. Any enemy moving within 10 feet takes 20 Radiant/Force damage on a failed Dexterity save.

spells.name: Arcology Sub-System Wards
spells.description: You ward an arcology vault or floor with confusion gas, illusory walls, and mag-locked doors.
spells.mechanics: Wards an area up to 200 feet square with fog, illusion corridors, and mag-locked doors.

spells.name: Sub-Dermal Targeting Assistant
spells.description: You touch a target and feed targeting telemetry into its HUD, granting a +d4 bonus to its next attack roll.
spells.mechanics: Target adds a d4 bonus to its next attack roll before the spell ends.

spells.name: High-Velocity Gyro-Bolt
spells.description: A high-velocity smart bolt streak hits a target, dealing damage and granting the next attacker advantage against it.
spells.mechanics: Make a ranged spell attack dealing 4d6 Radiant/Force damage. The next attack against the target before the end of your next turn has advantage.

spells.name: Pneumatic Air-Cannon Blast
spells.description: A roaring blast of compressed air and pneumatic force knocks down enemies and extinguishes fires.
spells.mechanics: A 60-foot line of compressed air forces creatures failing a Strength save back 15 feet and knocks them Prone.

spells.name: Ley-Line Sacred Ground Sanctification
spells.description: You sanctify an area up to a 60-foot radius, shielding it from extra-dimensional threats and corporate mages.
spells.mechanics: Wards a 60-foot area against extra-planar entities and applies custom buff/debuff zones.

spells.name: Holographic Environmental Simulator
spells.description: You project a massive holographic terrain simulation over a 150-foot area.
spells.mechanics: Alters the visual and acoustic appearance of terrain in a 150-foot cube.

spells.name: Bio-Cellular Rot Wave
spells.description: A wave of necrotic radiation causes organ failure and tissue necrosis in a target.
spells.mechanics: Target takes 14d6 Necrotic damage on a failed Constitution save, or half on a success.

spells.name: Synaptic Overclock Stim
spells.description: You flood a target's nervous system with hyper-reflex stims, doubling its speed and granting an extra action.
spells.mechanics: Target's speed is doubled, +2 AC, advantage on Dexterity saves, and gains an extra action on each turn. When it ends, the target suffers lethargy.

spells.name: High-Priority Medical Triage
spells.description: A massive surge of bio-nanites restores 70 Hit Points to a target and cures all blindness/deafness/diseases.
spells.mechanics: Target regains 70 Hit Points instantly and is cured of blindness, deafness, and diseases.

spells.name: Emergency Nanite Patch
spells.description: You beam a quick-patch wireless bio-nanite signal to heal a downed ally at range.
spells.mechanics: Target regains Hit Points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier as a bonus action.

spells.name: Thermal Induction Arc
spells.description: You superheat a metal object or weapon held by a target, burning them and forcing them to drop it.
spells.mechanics: Manufactured metal object glows red-hot, dealing 2d8 Fire damage to any creature touching it.

spells.name: High-Voltage Neural Backlash
spells.description: When damaged by an enemy, you retaliate with an instantaneous high-voltage arc blast.
spells.mechanics: In reaction to taking damage, attacker takes 2d10 Fire/Lightning damage on a failed Dexterity save.

spells.name: Synthesized Executive Feast
spells.description: You synthesize a luxurious executive banquet for up to 12 creatures that grants temp HP and immunity to poison/fear.
spells.mechanics: Feast for 12 creatures grants immunity to poison/fear, max HP increase by 2d10, and advantage on Wisdom saves for 24 hours.

spells.name: Adrenaline Adrenal Overdrive
spells.description: You inject a willing target with combat stims that make them immune to fear and grant temporary HP.
spells.mechanics: Target is immune to Frightened and gains 5 temporary Hit Points at the start of each turn.

spells.name: Subliminal Neural Hysteria
spells.description: You inject a viral laughing glitch into a target's brain, knocking them prone with uncontrollable laughter.
spells.mechanics: Target falls Prone and is Incapacitated with uncontrollable laughter on a failed Wisdom save.

spells.name: Neural System Freeze (Boss)
spells.description: You lock down a target creature's motor controls and neural pathways, paralyzing them.
spells.mechanics: Paralyzes a target creature on a failed Wisdom save. Target repeats save at the end of each turn.

spells.name: Neural System Freeze
spells.description: You lock down a humanoid's neural pathways, paralyzing them.
spells.mechanics: Paralyzes a humanoid target on a failed Wisdom save. Target repeats save at the end of each turn.

spells.name: Aegis Divine Protective Aura
spells.description: A blinding halo of hard-light energy grants allies resistance to all damage and advantage on saving throws.
spells.mechanics: Allies in a 30-foot radius have advantage on all saving throws and attackers have disadvantage on attack rolls against them.

spells.name: Smart-Link Target Tag
spells.description: You mark a single target with a smart-link lock, dealing an extra 1d6 damage on weapon hits.
spells.mechanics: Mark a target. Deal an extra 1d6 damage when hitting it with a weapon attack, and gain advantage on tracking checks.

spells.name: Strobe-Pulse Disorientation
spells.description: A 30-foot sphere of flashing neon lights disorients creatures and incapacitates them.
spells.mechanics: Pattern of flashing lights in a 30-foot cube causes targets failing a Wisdom save to become Incapacitated and mesmerized.

spells.name: Cryogenic Hailstorm
spells.description: Rock-hard ice chunks and cryogenic freezing mist pelt a 20-foot radius, dealing Bludgeoning and Cold damage.
spells.mechanics: Deals 2d8 Bludgeoning damage and 4d6 Cold damage in a 20-foot cylinder on a failed Dexterity save.

spells.name: Hardware Telemetry Analysis
spells.description: You scan a technological or magical item to instantly learn its functions, properties, and charges.
spells.mechanics: Learn the properties, charges, and spell/hack requirements of a object or item upon touch.

spells.name: Encrypted Scripting
spells.description: You write a piece of code or text that appears as gibberish to everyone except designated recipients.
spells.mechanics: Write an encrypted message that only you and designated individuals can read normally.

spells.name: Deep Matrix Imprisonment
spells.description: You trap a target's soul and physical form inside an unbreakable deep Matrix server cell.
spells.mechanics: Trap a target in an indestructible extra-dimensional prison cell (Burial, Chaining, Hedged Prison, Minimus Containment, Slumber).

spells.name: Incendiary Plasma Cloud
spells.description: A massive 20-foot cloud of super-heated plasma and white-hot fire roars across the battlefield.
spells.mechanics: Creates a 20-foot-radius cloud dealing 10d8 Fire damage to creatures starting their turn inside.

spells.name: Bio-Tox Touch
spells.description: You touch a target and discharge a concentrated surge of necrotic bio-toxin.
spells.mechanics: Make a melee spell attack dealing 3d10 Necrotic damage on a hit.

spells.name: Locust Drone Swarm
spells.description: A swarming cloud of razor-winged micro-drones bites and slashes targets in a 20-foot sphere.
spells.mechanics: Creates a 20-foot-radius sphere of biting micro-drones dealing 4d10 Piercing damage on a failed Constitution save.

spells.name: Teleporting Supply Crate
spells.description: You mark a supply crate or item that can be summoned to your hand from anywhere instantly.
spells.mechanics: Touch an object. At any later time, speak its command word to teleport the object directly to your hand.

spells.name: Thermo-Optic Camouflage Field
spells.description: A target becomes completely invisible to sight and thermal scanners until it attacks or casts a spell.
spells.mechanics: Target becomes invisible for 1 hour or until it attacks or casts a spell.

spells.name: Subliminal Rave Protocol
spells.description: You broadcast an irresistible synthwave beat that forces a target to dance uncontrollably.
spells.mechanics: Target must dance uncontrollably on a failed Wisdom save, losing its movement and taking disadvantage on DEX saves and attack rolls against it.

spells.name: Sub-Dermal Hydraulic Jump
spells.description: Your leg servos overcharge, tripling your jump distance.
spells.mechanics: Touch a creature to triple its jump distance for 1 minute.

spells.name: Mag-Lock Breaker
spells.description: A loud acoustic/electromagnetic pop blows open physical locks, mag-locks, and barred doors.
spells.mechanics: Unlocks or unbars an object within 60 feet, emitting a loud acoustic pop audible out to 300 feet.

spells.name: District History Query
spells.description: You query historical corporate databases to uncover secret lore regarding a legendary figure, location, or relic.
spells.mechanics: Learn legendary information about a person, place, or object.

spells.name: Targeted Cell Purge
spells.description: You purge one disease, poison, or physical condition (Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed) from a target.
spells.mechanics: Cure one disease or one condition (Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, Poisoned) on a target.

spells.name: Magnetic Repulsor Lift
spells.description: You project a vertical magnetic repulsor beam that lifts a creature or object up to 20 feet in mid-air.
spells.mechanics: Lifts a target up to 20 feet off the ground in mid-air. Target floats suspended.

spells.name: LED Spotlight Beam
spells.description: You touch an object to make it emit bright LED light in a 20-foot radius.
spells.mechanics: Object emits bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.

spells.name: High-Voltage Arc Discharge
spells.description: A 100-foot line of crackling 100,000-volt electricity blasts out from your palm emitter.
spells.mechanics: Deals 8d6 Lightning damage to all creatures in a 100-foot long, 5-foot wide line on a failed Dexterity save.

spells.name: GPS Botanical Tracker
spells.description: Your HUD highlights the direction and distance to the nearest specific plant, animal, or bio-drone within 5 miles.
spells.mechanics: Learn the direction and distance to the nearest plant or animal of a specific species within 5 miles.

spells.name: Biometric Target Tracker
spells.description: Your HUD tracks the biometric signature of a specific known creature within 1,000 feet.
spells.mechanics: Sense the location of a specific creature known to you within 1,000 feet.

spells.name: Asset RFID Tracker
spells.description: Your HUD tracks the location of a specific object within 1,000 feet.
spells.mechanics: Senses the location of a specific object within 1,000 feet.

spells.name: Sub-Dermal Muscle Overclock
spells.description: You overclock a target's leg actuators, increasing its movement speed by 10 feet.
spells.mechanics: Increases a target's movement speed by 10 feet for 1 hour.

spells.name: Sub-Dermal Ballistic Weave
spells.description: You coat an unarmored target's skin in protective sub-dermal mesh, setting its base AC to 13 + DEX.
spells.mechanics: Target's base AC becomes 13 + Dexterity modifier while unarmored for 8 hours.

spells.name: Hard-Light Kinetic Force-Palm
spells.description: A floating hard-light hand manipulates objects, presses buttons, or carries up to 10 lbs at range.
spells.mechanics: Create a spectral floating hand that can manipulate objects, open doors, or carry 10 lbs up to 30 feet away.

spells.name: Null-Signal Frequency Barrier
spells.description: Creates a 20-foot cylinder that blocks extra-dimensional entities and corporate mages from crossing.
spells.mechanics: Wards a 20-foot cylinder against extra-planar entities and prevents teleportation into the zone.

spells.name: Consciousness Trapping Drive
spells.description: You capture a dying target's soul/consciousness directly into an encrypted data drive upon death.
spells.mechanics: Traps the soul of a creature inside a gem/drive at the moment of death, preventing resurrection.

spells.name: Targeting Smart-Micro-Missiles
spells.description: You launch three auto-seeking micro-missiles that strike targets automatically without missing.
spells.mechanics: Fires three micro-missiles. Each strikes a target automatically for 1d4 + 1 Force damage.

spells.name: Voice-Synthesized Interface
spells.description: You encode a digital audio response script on an object that speaks aloud when triggered.
spells.mechanics: Programs an object to speak a message up to 25 words when a specified trigger event occurs.

spells.name: Monomolecular Edge Coating
spells.description: You coat a weapon in a monomolecular edge layer, turning it into a +1 magic weapon.
spells.mechanics: Target non-magical weapon becomes a +1 magic weapon for the duration.

spells.name: Virtual Arcology Penthouse
spells.description: You manifest a massive, luxurious extra-dimensional penthouse suite for up to 100 creatures.
spells.mechanics: Conjures an extra-dimensional mansion containing 50 rooms, staff, and food for 100 people for 24 hours.

spells.name: Holographic Projection Matrix
spells.description: You project a Large, complex holographic image complete with sound, smell, and temperature details.
spells.mechanics: Creates a complex visual, audio, and thermal illusion up to a 20-foot cube.

spells.name: High-Priority Nanite Resuscitation
spells.description: A massive bio-nanite wave heals up to six allies at range simultaneously.
spells.mechanics: Restores Hit Points equal to 3d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier to up to six targets.

spells.name: Executive Medical Regeneration
spells.description: A legendary surge of medical nanites restores 70 Hit Points to all allies within range and cures all conditions.
spells.mechanics: Restores 70 Hit Points to all allies within 60 feet and cures all diseases and conditions.

spells.name: Emergency Nanite Broadcast
spells.description: You beam a emergency patch signal restoring HP to up to six allies as a bonus action.
spells.mechanics: Restores 1d4 + spellcasting modifier Hit Points to up to six targets as a bonus action.

spells.name: Subliminal Crowd Manipulation
spells.description: You project a mass behavioral suggestion to up to twelve targets.
spells.mechanics: Implant a course of action into up to twelve humanoids on a failed Wisdom save.

spells.name: Matrix Firewall Isolation Cell
spells.description: You lock a target in a 20-foot extra-dimensional data cell where it can perform no actions.
spells.mechanics: Traps a target in a harmless extra-dimensional space on a failed Wisdom save.

spells.name: Sub-Dermal Concrete Integration
spells.description: You phase your physical form directly into concrete walls or stone barriers.
spells.mechanics: Merge your body and gear into a stone/concrete wall or surface for up to 8 hours.

spells.name: Micro-Solder Quick-Patch
components: (a spool of copper solder wire or micro-welding torch)
spells.description: You vent a micro-arc welding stream or nanite adhesive to fuse torn wiring, seal cracked casing, or repair fractured cyberware.
spells.mechanics: This spell repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch, such as a severed cable, cracked optic lens, or torn Kevlar jacket, provided the break is no larger than 1 foot in any dimension.

spells.name: Subliminal Comms Ping
spells.description: You transmit a short, direct audio frequency or sub-vocal comms ping directly into a target's ear implant or neural receiver.
spells.mechanics: You point your finger toward a creature within range and whisper a message. Only the target hears the message and can reply in a whisper that only you can hear. It can pass through solid objects, but is blocked by lead shielding or active jammer grids.

spells.name: Orbital Kinetic Carpet-Bomb
spells.description: You transmit orbital strike coordinates, calling down four massive tungsten rods and kinetic plasma rounds from a Kōten sky-arcology platform.
spells.mechanics: Four 40-foot-radius spheres of kinetic impact and plasma strike points within range. Each creature in an affected area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 20d6 Bludgeoning damage and 20d6 Fire damage on a failure, or half on a success. A creature in multiple areas takes damage only once.

spells.name: Neural Firewall Encryption
spells.description: You install an un-crackable military-grade neural firewall that isolates a target's consciousness from hostile Matrix entry, memory probes, and mind control.
spells.mechanics: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is immune to Psychic damage, thought-reading effects, mental location tracking, and the Charmed or Possession conditions.

spells.name: Holographic Projection Mesh
spells.description: You project a minor optical illusion, acoustic glitch, or holographic logo into an unoccupied 5-foot space.
spells.mechanics: You create a sound or an optical image of an object within range that lasts for 1 minute. Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion because things can pass through it.

spells.name: District-Wide Holo-Sim
spells.description: You project a massive, multi-block holographic environmental overlay that transforms the visual, acoustic, and atmospheric appearance of an entire district.
spells.mechanics: You alter the appearance of a 1-mile-square terrain area, changing its visible layout, structures, weather appearance, and sounds. Physical interaction reveals the hard-light illusion.

spells.name: Optical Decoy Shimmer
