spells.description: You project three holographic duplicate decoys that shift and interweave with your movements to confuse enemy targeting systems.
spells.mechanics: Three illusory duplicates of yourself appear in your space. Whenever a creature targets you with an attack, roll a d20 to determine whether it targets a duplicate instead (3 duplicates: 6+, 2 duplicates: 8+, 1 duplicate: 11+). A duplicate's AC equals 10 + your DEX modifier and is destroyed when hit.

spells.name: Active Optical Camouflage
spells.description: You activate an advanced optical cloak and holographic decoy feed that projects an illusory copy of yourself running in one direction while rendering you completely invisible.
spells.mechanics: You become Invisible at the same time an illusory double of you appears and runs up to your speed in a direction you choose. As a bonus action, you can move the double. The double lasts until the spell ends.

spells.name: Phase-Blink Step
spells.description: You instantly phase-shift through local Matrix data nodes, reappearing up to 30 feet away in a flash of digital static.
spells.mechanics: Briefly surrounded by digital distortion, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see.

spells.name: Memory Reprogramming Virus
spells.description: You execute a deep neural memory rewrite payload that edits, erases, or replaces a target's memories of events within the last 24 hours.
spells.mechanics: Target a creature within range. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become Subliminally Overridden (Charmed) for the duration. You can alter its memories of an event that took place within the last 24 hours (lasting up to 10 minutes), erasing, altering, or fabricating details.

spells.name: Lunar Energy Beam
spells.description: A 5-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder of silver astral energy beam beams down from orbit, searing enemies and revealing shapeshifters.
spells.mechanics: A cylinder of pale silver light shines down. Creatures entering or starting their turn in the cylinder must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 2d10 Radiant damage on a failure, or half on a success. Shapechangers make the save with disadvantage and revert to their true form on a failure.

spells.name: Sub-Dermal Concrete Sculpting
spells.description: You overwrite local structural concrete, asphalt, or soil, reshaping terrain, carving trenches, or digging subterranean bypasses.
spells.mechanics: Reshape terrain in a 40-foot cube (Excavating trenches, leveling hills, reshaping dirt/stone/concrete, or creating difficult terrain).

spells.name: Signal Jammer Mask
spells.description: You coat a target or chip in signal-dampening lead paint and encryption routines, masking it from optical scanners and Matrix tracing.
spells.mechanics: For the duration, a willing creature or object touched cannot be targeted by divination magic, scrying sensors, or digital tracking devices.

spells.name: Low-Signature Stealth Protocol
components: (a pinch of ash or stealth thread)
spells.description: You broadcast an optical and acoustic dampening field around your team, suppressing footsteps and optical reflections.
spells.mechanics: You and up to ten creatures you choose within 30 feet gain a +10 bonus to Low-Signature (Stealth) checks and leave no physical tracks or biometric residues.

spells.name: Structural Vaporizer Tunnel
spells.description: You deploy a line of industrial nanite disintegrators that instantly carves a 5-foot-wide, 10-foot-high, 20-foot-deep tunnel through solid concrete, steel, or stone.
spells.mechanics: A passage opens up in a wooden, plaster, concrete, or stone surface within range, up to 5 feet wide, 8 feet high, and 20 feet deep. When the spell ends, the passage closes smoothly.

spells.name: Subliminal Terror Nightmare
spells.description: You project an isolated holographic nightmare directly into a target's neural interface, conjuring its worst fears.
spells.mechanics: Target a creature within range. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become Threat-Locked (Frightened) for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, it must repeat the save, taking 4d10 Psychic damage on a failure.

spells.name: Cyber-Bike Fast-Deploy
spells.description: You materialize an illusory hard-light combat bike or fast-transit vehicle that carries a rider across urban terrain.
spells.mechanics: Manifest an illusory riding horse or light vehicle. It moves at 100 feet per round and can carry one rider. It dissolves if it takes any damage.

spells.name: Astral Contractor Proxy
spells.description: You submit a high-priority request to an extra-dimensional corporate board or spirit court, summoning a powerful celestial or demon contractor.
spells.mechanics: You request aid from a powerful extra-planar entity (an Astral Contractor). The entity expects a contract payment or favor in exchange for its services.

spells.name: Astral Contract Binding
spells.description: You execute a binding neural contract that traps a summoned spirit, demon, or celestial entity in your service for up to 24 hours.
spells.mechanics: Binds a target extra-planar entity (celestial, elemental, fey, or fiend) to your service. It must make a Charisma saving throw; on a failure, it obeys your commands for the duration.

spells.name: Matrix Transit Shift
components: (a tuning fork set to a digital node)
spells.description: You and up to eight willing allies phase through the Matrix infrastructure, instantly teleporting to a distant global server node or dimension.
spells.mechanics: You and up to eight willing creatures teleport to a designated destination node on another plane or distant location on the globe.

spells.name: Accelerated Bio-Flora Growth
spells.description: You release a heavy botanical growth agent that causes urban weeds, bio-engineered vines, and rooftop flora to instantly overgrow.
spells.mechanics: In a 100-foot radius, plants instantly overgrow, creating difficult terrain. Alternatively, enrich crop yield in a half-mile radius over 8 hours.

spells.name: Aerosolized Bio-Toxin Jet
spells.description: You vent a cloud of toxic gas and hardware-corroding chemicals from your sub-dermal wrist nozzle.
spells.mechanics:
Target a creature within 10 feet. It must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d12 Poison damage.
Scaling: Damage increases by 1d12 at 5th level (2d12), 11th level (3d12), and 17th level (4d12).

spells.name: Bio-Form Mutagen Overwrite
spells.description: You forcibly rewrite a target's physical genetic code, mutating it into a harmless harmless beast or apex bio-drone.
spells.mechanics: Target a creature within range. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be transformed into a beast of CR equal to or lower than its level/CR for the duration.

spells.name: Kill-Code Execution Protocol
spells.description: You speak a high-level corporate kill-code that instantly shuts down the neural heart rate and brain function of a target with 100 HP or less.
spells.mechanics: You utter a command word. If the target has 100 Hit Points or fewer, it dies instantly. Otherwise, the spell has no effect.

spells.name: Neural Shock-Stun Protocol
spells.description: You broadcast an intense high-frequency shock pulse that instantly stuns a target with 150 HP or less.
spells.mechanics: Target a creature within 60 feet. If it has 150 Hit Points or fewer, it is Stunned until the end of your next turn.

spells.name: Emergency Cellular Triage
spells.description: You deploy a field medical nanite cloud that heals up to six wounded allies during short rests.
spells.mechanics: Up to six creatures regain 2d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier Hit Points at the end of a 10-minute medical triage session.

spells.name: Micro-Holo & Acoustic Utility
spells.description: You execute minor technical utility routines: igniting synth-cigarettes, changing shirt neon colors, or generating minor synth-flavors.
spells.mechanics: Perform minor utility tricks (sparking a small fire, cleaning an item, changing neon clothing trim, generating a minor scent or flavor).

spells.name: Prismatic Refraction Laser Strike
spells.description: Eight multi-colored laser beams detonate from your optical array in a 60-foot cone, inflicting varied elemental and status effects.
spells.mechanics: Each creature in a 60-foot cone takes damage and effects based on random laser color rolls (Red: 10d6 Fire, Orange: 10d6 Acid, Yellow: 10d6 Lightning, Green: 10d6 Poison, Blue: 10d6 Cold, Indigo: Restrained, Violet: Blinded).

spells.name: Hard-Light Prismatic Citadel
spells.description: You project an impenetrable, 90-foot-wide hard-light laser dome consisting of seven multi-colored protective layers.
spells.mechanics: Creates a dome made of 7 distinct colored energy layers. Each layer blocks specific damage types, spells, and physical movement, and must be destroyed by specific counter-measures.

spells.name: Data-Vault Isolation Chamber
spells.description: You encase a 30-foot cube in an opaque hard-light force field that blocks all physical entry, optical sensors, and wireless signals.
spells.mechanics: Creates an isolated 30-foot cube that blocks sound, wireless signals, visual scrying, and physical entry.

spells.name: Sub-Dermal Plasma Arc Emitter
spells.description: You ignite a small flame or plasma arc at your fingertip that can illuminate dark alleyways or ignite flammable fuel.
spells.mechanics: A flame appears in your hand for 10 minutes (bright light 10ft). You can throw it up to 30 feet to make a ranged spell attack dealing 1d8 Fire damage.

spells.name: Hard-Light Timed Hologram
spells.description: You program an intricate holographic illusion up to a 30-foot cube that activates automatically when specific triggers occur.
spells.mechanics: Create a complex visual and auditory illusion that activates upon a set trigger condition and follows a pre-programmed script.

spells.name: Hard-Light Holo-Avatar
spells.description: You project an interactive hard-light avatar of yourself anywhere within 500 miles, allowing you to speak, see, and cast spells through it.
spells.mechanics: Project an intangible copy of yourself anywhere within range. You can see, hear, speak, and cast spells through the image.

spells.name: Elemental Shielding Protocol
spells.description: You coat a target in energy-dampening insulation, granting resistance to one specific energy type (Fire, Cold, Lightning, Acid, Sonic).
spells.mechanics: Target creature gains resistance to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage for the duration.

spells.name: Aegis Anti-Corporate Protection
spells.description: You install a protective firewall against hostile extra-dimensional entities, spirits, and mind-control hacks.
spells.mechanics: Target gains +2 AC and saving throws against Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead, and immunity to Charm/Frightened from them.

spells.name: Bio-Tox Antitoxin Injector
spells.description: You inject a neutralizing anti-toxin serum that cures poisons and grants resistance to chemical toxins.
spells.mechanics: Touch a creature to neutralize one poison affecting it. For the duration, it has advantage on saves against poison and resistance to Poison damage.

spells.name: Bio-Filter Purifier
spells.description: You deploy micro-filters to neutralize bio-toxins, heavy radiation, and pollutants in food and water within 5 feet.
spells.mechanics: All non-magical food and drink within a 5-foot-radius sphere is purified and freed of poison and disease.

spells.name: High-Tier Cybernetic Resuscitation
spells.description: You use trauma-surge defibrillators and neural reconstructors to revive a target that died within the last 10 days.
spells.mechanics: Revive a dead creature that died within the last 10 days with 1 Hit Point, restoring missing limbs and organs.

spells.name: Sub-Dermal Bio-Siphon
spells.description: A beam of necrotic energy drains a target's muscle strength, cutting its physical attack damage in half.
spells.mechanics: Target a creature within range. On a hit, it takes 2d6 Necrotic damage and its weapon attacks dealing Strength damage deal half damage until the spell ends.

spells.name: Cryo-Beam Cannon
spells.description: You fire a beam of sub-zero cryogenic fluid that freezes a target's leg joints and reduces its speed.
spells.mechanics:
Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Cold damage and its movement speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
Scaling: Damage increases by 1d8 at 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

spells.name: Bio-Nanite Cellular Regeneration
spells.description: You inject a continuous stream of cellular repair nanites that restores HP every round and regrows severed limbs.
spells.mechanics: Target regains 4d8 + 15 Hit Points instantly, and 1 Hit Point at the start of each of its turns for 1 hour. Severed body parts are reattached or regrown.

spells.name: Replicant Genetic Resynthesis
spells.description: You rebuild a deceased target's physical body into a new metahuman replica body, transferring its soul into the new frame.
spells.mechanics: Rebuild a dead creature into a new body (rolling on a metahuman heritage table to determine its new physical species).

spells.name: Firewall Malware Scrub
spells.description: You run a deep system antivirus scrub that purges curses, corporate tracking bugs, and malicious hacks from a target.
spells.mechanics: At touch, all curses, malwares, and tracking bugs affecting a target or object immediately end.

spells.name: Hard-Light Containment Sphere
spells.description: You trap a target inside an indestructible 10-foot hard-light kinetic force sphere.
spells.mechanics: Encloses a Large or smaller creature in an indestructible sphere of force on a failed Dexterity save. Nothing can pass through the sphere.

spells.name: Emergency System Defenses
spells.description: You touch a target to reinforce its saving throws with a +d4 defense buffer.
spells.mechanics: Target adds a d4 bonus to its saving throws for the duration.

spells.name: Full Cybernetic Reconstruction
spells.description: You fully reconstruct a deceased target's body and neural network, reviving it even if only a scrap of DNA remains.
spells.mechanics: Revives a dead creature that died up to 100 years ago, reconstructing missing organs, limbs, and body parts.

spells.name: Gravitational Inversion Field
spells.description: You invert gravity in a 50-foot-radius, 100-foot-high cylinder, causing enemies and unanchored objects to fall upward.
spells.mechanics: Gravity reverses upward in a 50-foot radius cylinder. Unanchored creatures fall upward 100 feet, slamming into ceilings for falling damage.

spells.name: Field Defibrillator Pulse
spells.description: You discharge a high-voltage defibrillator strike directly into a target that died within the last 1 minute, reviving it with 1 HP.
spells.mechanics: Revives a creature that died within the last 1 minute, restoring it to life with 1 Hit Point.

spells.name: Deployable Micro-Safehouse
spells.description: You drop a high-tensile wire upward that opens an invisible 8-person pocket safehouse in the air.
spells.mechanics: A 50-foot rope rises into the air, leading to an invisible extra-dimensional safehouse that holds up to eight creatures.

spells.name: Sub-Dermal Laser Beam
spells.description: You fire a beam of bright laser light from your palm or focus that deals Radiant damage.
spells.mechanics:
Make a ranged spell attack dealing 1d8 Radiant damage on a hit.
Scaling: Increases by 1d8 at 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

spells.name: Aegis Hard-Light Barrier
spells.description: You project a floating hard-light aegis shield in front of an ally, granting them a +2 AC bonus.
spells.mechanics: A willing creature within range gains a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

spells.name: Thermite Cluster Launch
spells.description: You launch three burning thermite explosive clusters that strike single or multiple targets.
spells.mechanics:
Create three fiery bolts. Make a ranged spell attack for each bolt, dealing 2d6 Fire damage per bolt on a hit.
At Higher Levels: Fires 1 additional bolt for each slot level above 2nd.

spells.name: Matrix Scrying Drone
spells.description: You project an invisible wireless scrying sensor over a target anywhere in Neo-Tokyo to watch and listen to it.
spells.mechanics: You see and hear a specific target creature on a failed Wisdom saving throw, moving a scrying sensor with it.

spells.name: Encrypted Stash Lockbox
spells.description: You hide a heavy gear chest in a pocket dimension, summoning or hiding it with a replica key.
spells.mechanics: Hides a chest holding up to 12 cubic feet of gear in an extra-dimensional plane, accessible via a replica key.

spells.name: Thermal Optics Sweep
spells.description: Your optics switch to thermal-infrared mode, highlighting invisible targets and optical stealth cloaks within 30 feet.
spells.mechanics: You can see invisible creatures and objects as if they were visible out to 30 feet.

spells.name: Holographic Persona Cloak
spells.description: You project custom holographic disguises over up to six allies to disguise them as corporate guards or idols.
spells.mechanics: Change the physical appearance of up to six willing targets for 8 hours (Charisma save to see through).

spells.name: Wireless Audio/Text Signal
spells.description: You transmit a 25-word encrypted text or audio message directly to a target's neural receiver anywhere in the world.
spells.mechanics: Send a message of 25 words or less to a creature you are familiar with. It hears the message in its mind and can reply immediately.

spells.name: Deep-Net Data Vault Stasis
spells.description: You lock an object or target in stasis inside a digital vault, making it immune to damage, aging, and scrying.
spells.mechanics: Target is put into suspended animation, making it immune to aging, damage, and divination magic until triggered.

spells.name: Biological Species Overwrite
spells.description: You rewrite a target's physical genetic structure permanently into any other metahuman species, dragon, or beast.
spells.mechanics: Transform a target into another creature of equal or lower CR/level permanently if concentration is maintained for 1 hour.

spells.name: Acoustic Shatter Pulse
spells.description: You emit a loud, high-frequency sonic pulse that shatters glass, structural barriers, and deafens enemies.
spells.mechanics: Creatures in a 10-foot sphere take 3d8 Thunder/Sonic damage on a failed Constitution save. Non-magical inorganic objects take extra damage.

spells.name: Sub-Dermal Reactive Firewall
spells.description: When targeted by an attack or Magic Missile, you project a hard-light energy barrier that grants a +5 AC bonus.
spells.mechanics: In reaction to being hit by an attack, gain a +5 bonus to AC until the start of your next turn and immunity to Magic Missile.

spells.name: Aegis Kinetic Barrier
spells.description: You project a floating hard-light barrier that grants an ally a +2 AC bonus.
spells.mechanics: Target creature within range gains a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

spells.name: Monofilament Weapon Coating
spells.description: You coat a wooden staff or club in monofilament wire, allowing you to use your spellcasting stat for melee attack rolls.
spells.mechanics: Touch a wooden weapon. For 1 minute, use your spellcasting ability instead of Strength for attack/damage rolls, dealing 1d8 damage.

spells.name: High-Voltage Taser Palm
spells.description: You discharge a high-voltage taser strike from your palm, dealing Lightning damage and preventing reactions.
spells.mechanics:
Make a melee spell attack (advantage if target wears metal armor). On a hit, deal 1d8 Lightning damage and target cannot take reactions.
Scaling: Increases by 1d8 at 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

spells.name: Acoustic Muffle Field
spells.description: You project a 20-foot sound-proof barrier that silences all gunfire, footsteps, and spoken spell code inside.
spells.mechanics: No sound can be created within or pass through a 20-foot sphere. Creatures inside are Deafened and immune to Thunder damage.

spells.name: Holographic Decoy Display
spells.description: You project a simple visual or audio hologram (no larger than a 15-foot cube) within range.
spells.mechanics: Create a purely visual or auditory image up to a 15-foot cube. Physical interaction reveals it to be an illusion.

spells.name: Hard-Light Replicant Construct
spells.description: You fabricate an identical hard-light or bio-synthetic duplicate of a target that possesses half its stats and abilities.
spells.mechanics: Creates an illusory duplicate of a target creature with half its maximum Hit Points that obeys your commands.

spells.name: Subliminal Sleep Signal
spells.description: You broadcast a soothing acoustic frequency that knocks low-tier targets unconscious in a 20-foot sphere.
spells.mechanics: Roll 5d8; the total is how many Hit Points of creatures in a 20-foot sphere this spell can knock unconscious.

spells.name: Cryogenic Blizzard Cloud
spells.description: A 40-foot cylinder fills with freezing blizzard winds, blinding targets and extinguishing fires.
spells.mechanics: Creates a 40-foot-wide, 20-foot-high cylinder of freezing snow that heavily obscures the area and deals 2d6 Cold damage.

spells.name: Neural Reflex Delay
spells.description: You inject a reflex-delay glitch into up to six targets, cutting their movement speed in half and removing reactions.
spells.mechanics: Up to six targets failing a Wisdom save have speed halved, -2 AC/DEX saves, and cannot take reactions or multi-attacks.

spells.name: Stabilization Defibrillator Ping
spells.description: You discharge a gentle defibrillator pulse to instantly stabilize a dying target at 0 HP.
spells.mechanics: Touch a living creature at 0 Hit Points to stabilize it.

spells.name: Critter Neural Interlink
spells.description: Your translator translates the vocalizations and body language of urban critters and animals.
spells.mechanics: Comprehend and communicate verbally with beasts for the duration.

spells.name: Cyber-Zombie Neural Interlink
spells.description: Your neural link interrogates a corpse, asking up to five questions before its brain decays.
spells.mechanics: Interrogate a corpse with intact vocal cords, asking up to five questions.

spells.name: Bio-Flora Interlink
spells.description: You query urban rooftop gardens and mutated flora to learn events that occurred in the area.
spells.mechanics: Commune with plants within 30 feet to learn about events, creatures, and paths.

spells.name: Pneumatic Wall-Climber Actuators
components: (a drop of pitch and a spider)
spells.description: Pneumatic suction cups and magnetic micro-hooks allow a target to scale vertical arcology walls effortlessly.
spells.mechanics: Target creature gains a climbing speed equal to its walking speed and can move across vertical surfaces and ceilings.

spells.name: Monofilament Trap Array
spells.description: A 20-foot square area fills with razor-sharp monofilament tripwires that slash creatures moving through.
spells.mechanics: Creates difficult terrain in a 20-foot square. Moving through deals 2d4 Piercing/Slashing damage for every 5 feet.

spells.name: Aegis Hard-Light Combat Sentries
spells.description: Three hovering hard-light sentries orbit you, striking any enemy that enters within 15 feet.
spells.mechanics: Hard-light sentries deal 3d8 Radiant/Force damage to enemies entering within 15 feet on a failed Wisdom save.

spells.name: Hard-Light Floating Turret
spells.description: You manifest a hovering hard-light energy turret that shoots lasers as a bonus action.
spells.mechanics: Create a floating spectral turret. Make a melee spell attack dealing 1d8 + spellcasting modifier Force damage as a bonus action.

spells.name: Neuro-Toxic Gas Venter
spells.description: A 20-foot sphere fills with foul neuro-toxic gas that causes targets to gag and become Incapacitated.
spells.mechanics: Creates a 20-foot sphere of yellow gas. Creatures failing a Constitution save are Incapacitated on their turn.

spells.name: Sub-Dermal Concrete Shaping
spells.description: You instantly reshape a 5-foot cube of concrete, rock, or masonry into any form or door passageway.
spells.mechanics: Reshape a block of stone/concrete no larger than 5 feet in any dimension into a desired shape.

spells.name: Sub-Dermal Titanium Skin
spells.description: A target's skin hardens into rock-hard titanium plating, granting resistance to non-magical kinetic damage.
spells.mechanics: Target gains resistance to non-magical Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

spells.name: Orbital Thunderstorm Array
spells.description: A massive 360-foot hurricane storm clouds over the district, dealing torrential acid rain, lightning, and hail damage.
spells.mechanics: Creates a massive storm. Deals 2d6 Thunder damage, 1d6 Cold damage, 10d6 Lightning damage, and 2d6 Acid damage in stages.

spells.name: Subliminal Behavioral Override
spells.description: You implant a compelling course of action into a target, forcing it to carry out the command.
spells.mechanics: Implant a reasonable command into a target on a failed Wisdom save. It carries out the task for up to 8 hours.

spells.name: Sub-Dermal Thermal Laser Beam
spells.description: You project a 60-foot radiant laser beam from your chest focus that deals 6d8 Radiant damage each turn.
spells.mechanics: A 60-foot line of bright light deals 6d8 Radiant damage to creatures failing a Constitution save, and blinds them.

spells.name: Orbital Solar Flare Nova
spells.description: A blinding 60-foot sphere of solar plasma detonates, dealing 12d6 Radiant damage and blinding all targets.
spells.mechanics: A 60-foot sphere detonates dealing 12d6 Radiant damage to creatures failing a Constitution save, and blinding them.

spells.name: Mag-Lock Trap / System Glyph
spells.description: You etch a deadly security glyph on a surface that triggers Death, Discord, Fear, Hopelessness, Insanity, Pain, or Sleep.
spells.mechanics: Inscribe a master glyph that triggers devastating status effects in a 60-foot sphere when activated.

spells.name: Hard-Light Hydraulic Tether
spells.description: A hard-light kinetic beam grabs a creature or 5,000 lb object, lifting or throwing it across the field.
spells.mechanics: Move a creature or object weighing up to 5,000 lbs up to 30 feet in any direction on a failed Strength save.

spells.name: Encrypted Sub-Net Channel
spells.description: You establish a private 8-way encrypted telepathic channel across all team members.
spells.mechanics: Link up to eight willing creatures telepathically across any distance on the same plane.

spells.name: Matrix Transit Network Shift
spells.description: You instantly phase your team through the global transit grid to any known location.
spells.mechanics: Teleport yourself and up to eight willing creatures to a destination you are familiar with.

spells.name: Transit Grid Node Circle
spells.description: You link a local chalk/digital circle to a permanent transit node anywhere in Neo-Tokyo.
spells.mechanics: Opens a 1-round portal linking your current circle to a permanent teleportation circle elsewhere.

spells.name: Digital Hologram Utility
spells.description: You project minor digital glimmers, loud synth horns, or flickering lights to distract targets.
spells.mechanics: Create three minor sensory effects (booming voice, flickering lights, minor tremors, or sparks).

spells.name: Acoustic Shockwave Pulse
spells.description: A 15-foot blast of sonic shockwave force pushes enemies back 10 feet and shatters windows.
spells.mechanics: Each creature in a 15-foot cube takes 2d8 Thunder damage and is pushed 10 feet away on a failed Constitution save.

spells.name: Quantum System Lag
spells.description: You freeze global time and digital streams around you for 1d4 + 1 rounds, taking actions freely.
spells.mechanics: Briefly stop time for 1d4 + 1 turns, during which you can move and act while all other creatures are frozen.

spells.name: Deployable Micro-Bunker
spells.description: You deploy a 10-foot hard-light opaque security dome that holds up to nine allies safely.
spells.mechanics: Creates an impenetrable 10-foot dome that holds up to nine creatures. The interior is climate-controlled.

spells.name: Neural Linguistic Translator
spells.description: You upload a universal translation script into a target, allowing it to understand all languages.
spells.mechanics: Target understands any spoken language it hears and can speak any language fluently for 1 hour.

spells.name: Bio-Flora Transit Bypass
spells.description: You step into a living bio-plant and teleport out of another plant anywhere on the continent.
spells.mechanics: Step into a Large or larger plant and exit from another plant of the same kind anywhere on the same plane.

spells.name: Rooftop Bio-Flora Jump
spells.description: You step into a living plant and teleport up to 500 feet to another plant as a bonus action.
spells.mechanics: Use 10 feet of movement to enter a plant and teleport to another plant within 500 feet once per turn.

spells.name: Biomass Rewrite Protocol
spells.description: You rewrite a target's physical code, mutating it permanently into any creature or object.
spells.mechanics: Transform a creature into any other creature or object permanently if concentration is held for 1 hour.

spells.name: Executive Cloning Resuscitation
spells.description: You revive a target that died up to 200 years ago, constructing a brand new flawless body.
spells.mechanics: Restores a creature to life that died up to 200 years ago with full Hit Points and no missing body parts.

spells.name: Sub-Dermal Sensor Scan
spells.description: Your optics gain True Sight out to 120 feet, seeing through illusions, stealth cloaks, and matrix shifts.
spells.mechanics: Gain True Sight out to 120 feet for 1 hour, seeing through illusions, darkness, and secret doors.

spells.name: Sub-Dermal Targeting Paint
spells.description: Your HUD tags a target, granting you advantage on your next attack roll.
spells.mechanics: Gain advantage on your next attack roll against a target before the end of your next turn.

spells.name: Hard-Light Automation Unit
spells.description: You manifest an invisible hard-light drone that performs mundane tasks like cleaning, carrying gear, and pouring drinks.
spells.mechanics: Creates an invisible, unaligned force construct with STR 2 that performs simple physical chores.

spells.name: Bio-Nanite Life Drain
spells.description: You touch a target and siphon its life force, dealing Necrotic damage and healing yourself for half.
spells.mechanics: Make a melee spell attack dealing 3d6 Necrotic damage, healing yourself for half the damage dealt.

spells.name: Subliminal Sonic Mockery
spells.description: You broadcast a sting of acoustic insults directly into a target's ear implant, dealing Psychic damage and giving disadvantage on its next attack.
spells.mechanics:
Target failing a Wisdom save takes 1d4 Psychic damage and has disadvantage on its next attack roll.
Scaling: Damage increases by 1d4 at 5th level (2d4), 11th level (3d4), and 17th level (4d4).

spells.name: Hard-Light Napalm Barrier
spells.description: A 60-foot wall of roaring plasma fire erupts, burning creatures that pass through.
spells.mechanics: Creates a wall of fire up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick. Passing through deals 5d8 Fire damage.

spells.name: Hard-Light Kinetic Wall
spells.description: An indestructible wall of hard-light force blocks physical attacks, bullets, and spells.
spells.mechanics: Creates an invisible, indestructible wall of force up to 10 10x10 foot panels. Nothing can pass through.

spells.name: Cryogenic Glitch Barrier
spells.description: A 60-foot wall of solid ice blocks physical movement and deals Cold damage when shattered.
spells.mechanics: Creates a wall of ice up to 10 10x10 foot panels with 30 HP per panel. Breaching a panel deals 10d6 Cold damage.

spells.name: Sub-Dermal Concrete Rampart
spells.description: A 60-foot wall of solid reinforced concrete erupts from the pavement to provide cover.
spells.mechanics: Creates a wall of solid stone up to 6 10x10 foot panels with 30 HP per panel.

spells.name: Monofilament Razor Wall
spells.description: A wall of razor-sharp monofilament tripwires and carbon thorns slashes creatures attempting to cross.
spells.mechanics: Creates a wall of monofilament thorns up to 60 feet long, 10 feet high, dealing 7d8 Piercing/Slashing damage to creatures entering.

spells.name: Shared Damage Firewall
spells.description: You link your protective AC and saving throw bonuses to an ally, splitting incoming damage between you.
spells.mechanics: Target gains +1 AC and saving throws, and takes half damage from attacks, with you taking the other half.

spells.name: Sub-Dermal Gills & Hydro-Filters
spells.description: You grant up to ten willing allies sub-dermal gill filters that allow them to breathe underwater.
spells.mechanics: Up to ten willing creatures gain the ability to breathe underwater for 24 hours.

spells.name: Hydro-Repulsor Surface Treaders
spells.description: You activate magnetic repulsor soles that allow up to ten allies to run across water surfaces.
spells.mechanics: Up to ten willing creatures gain the ability to move across liquid surfaces as if they were solid ground.

spells.name: High-Tensile Cable Web
spells.description: A massive 20-foot cube of sticky monofilament cables traps and restrains creatures.
spells.mechanics: Fills a 20-foot cube with sticky web cables. Creatures entering must succeed on a Dexterity save or be Restrained.

spells.name: Neural Hallucinatory Overload
spells.description: You flood all targets in a 30-foot sphere with terrifying neural illusions that deal 10d10 Psychic damage per turn.
spells.mechanics: Targets in a 30-foot sphere take 10d10 Psychic damage on a failed Intelligence save and become Frightened.

spells.name: Aerosolized Cloud Flight
spells.description: You convert up to ten willing creatures into gaseous mist clouds that fly at 300 feet per round.
spells.mechanics: Up to ten willing creatures transform into gaseous mist clouds with a flying speed of 300 feet for 8 hours.

spells.name: Acoustic Deflection Barrier
spells.description: A 50-foot wall of high-pressure acoustic wind deflects ranged attacks and pushes creatures back.
spells.mechanics: Creates a wall of high-pressure wind 50 feet long, 15 feet high that deflects ranged attacks and forces flying creatures back.

spells.name: Quantum Matrix Alteration
spells.description: You alter reality itself by rewriting the core digital source code of the universe to grant any desired spell effect.
spells.mechanics: The ultimate spell. Duplicates any 8th-level or lower spell instantly without components, or alters reality at severe risk.

spells.name: Emergency Extraction Beacon
spells.description: You and up to five allies instantly teleport to a pre-designated safehouse or medical extraction point.
spells.mechanics: Instantly teleports you and up to five willing creatures to a sanctuary location designated when you last rested.

spells.name: Biometric Truth Scanner
spells.description: You project an acoustic truth-field that prevents creatures inside a 15-foot sphere from speaking deliberate lies.
spells.mechanics: Creatures in a 15-foot sphere failing a Charisma save cannot tell a deliberate lie while inside the area.

The creature’s attack rolls have disadvantage.
